body:
This stacked draft extends #48 with **36 executed mathematical investigations and eight hostile audit assignments**, performed by six research workers plus the principal. It adds source-changing joint-law Bayesian transport, a Lean finite-branching history-realization theorem, and exact countermodels for destructive observation, nonregular cover descent, hidden memory, quantum backaction and filtered fluid closure.

The audits sharpened conditional total-variation stability to ε/max(α,β), corrected the arithmetic two-bump argument's missing window hypothesis, and hardened the source-hash and compiler-rejection gates. Classical theorem families and existing EOS refinement mathematics are attributed. The natural-acim comparison and unrestricted representation invention remain conditional/unachieved; no academic priority or RH/Weil-positivity claim is made.

[Campaign report A–I](https://github.com/femboy2112/SUCC/blob/research/cambrian-observational-realization-2026-10-13/docs/CAMBRIAN_CAMPAIGN_2026-10-13.md) · [44-assignment manifest](https://github.com/femboy2112/SUCC/blob/research/cambrian-observational-realization-2026-10-13/research/2026-10-13/CAMBRIAN_SWARM_MANIFEST.json) · [Validation receipt](https://github.com/femboy2112/SUCC/blob/research/cambrian-observational-realization-2026-10-13/research/2026-10-13/CAMBRIAN_VALIDATION.json)

Validation completed locally:
- 1,716 full-suite tests; required provenance (72 entries), foundations and ordinal probes.
- All seven campaign/root receipts, independent audits A/B/F/G, and four inherited EODCS/Voyager receipts replayed.
- Nine Lean 4.14 modules; dependencies of 65 production theorems inspected; independent positive appendix and four calibrated rejected controls.
- Historical imports and O1–O638 preserved; additive ledger O639–O679.

Base: `5eb09e7cba36ec01b8f9d6834b78b5766fd93935`.
Publication head: `bdb1fcfce875ee6c51fc62f78fbb4111582caadc`.
Content tree: `2391f7aef24990f55ff46a3abefc4010b691bf94`, exactly matching the tested local publication tree.

Native git push had no credentials. Publication used the connected GitHub API; the exact original worker/audit/local integration commits are retained in a verified, reproducible Git bundle under `provenance/cambrian/`. The API commit is not mislabeled as an original worker commit. PR45 remains a separate Lean4.19 lineage; no formal material from it was imported.

Exact-head GitHub CI: **all four workflows passed on `bdb1fcfce875ee6c51fc62f78fbb4111582caadc`**, for both push and pull-request events. The full Python 3.10 and 3.13 jobs each report **1,716 tests passed**. Main, releases, tags and defaults are unchanged.

| Final-head workflow | Verified PR run |
|---|---|
| Full Python 3.10/3.13 and inherited source/proof guards | [38365271651](https://github.com/femboy2112/SUCC/actions/runs/38365271651) |
| Cambrian tests and exact research/audit receipt replay, Python 3.10/3.13 | [38365271625](https://github.com/femboy2112/SUCC/actions/runs/38365271625) |
| Pinned Lean 4.14, 65 production theorem dependencies and calibrated controls | [38365271642](https://github.com/femboy2112/SUCC/actions/runs/38365271642) |
| Exact EODCS/Voyager hostile controls and frozen receipts | [38365271684](https://github.com/femboy2112/SUCC/actions/runs/38365271684) |

Publication follow-up: the first remote Lean kernel/audit passed, while a legacy substring scanner falsely matched `admit` inside the comment word `admits`. The final head fixes the scanner with comment-aware token checks and retained negative controls. [The initial failed run](https://github.com/femboy2112/SUCC/actions/runs/38364586119) remains recorded.

Concurrent drafts #49 and #50 contain overlapping classical mathematics and distinct formal developments, including #50's separately reported topology-library proof. Their exact snapshots and scoped overlap are attributed in `CAMBRIAN_PUBLICATION_NOTES.md`; no sibling files were imported or changed. Their global ledgers still equal O1–O638, so no global-ID collision was found. Their supplementary namespaces need reconciliation before a future merge.

Sibling topology scope was checked directly at #50 head `2e1bda55799e1e1f2c516e472c4fa169fc9692f8`: [`SwarmTopology.lean`](https://github.com/femboy2112/SUCC/blob/2e1bda55799e1e1f2c516e472c4fa169fc9692f8/formal/swarm_topology/SwarmTopology.lean) proves deterministic-trace closure/finite compatibility and compact-source actualization for discrete outcomes, with mathlib pin `4bbdccd9c5f862bf90ff12f0a9e2c8be032b9a84`. Its [topology CI step](https://github.com/femboy2112/SUCC/actions/runs/38362335675) passed at that sibling head. This is separately credited and was not imported or locally rebuilt here; our new kernel theorem concerns changing, nondeterministic, finitely branching histories.
